package com.example.app;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Javadoc for the class.
 * @author someone
 */
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
public final class Inventory<T extends Comparable<T>> implements Iterable<T> {
    private static final int DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 16;
    private final List<T> items = new ArrayList<>(DEFAULT_CAPACITY);

    public Inventory() {
        super();
    }

    public record Entry(String name, int count) {}

    @Override
    public java.util.Iterator<T> iterator() {
        return items.iterator();
    }

    public synchronized void add(T item) throws IllegalArgumentException {
        if (item == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("item must not be null");
        }
        items.add(item);
    }

    public static <K, V> Map<K, List<V>> group(
            List<V> values,
            java.util.function.Function<V, K> key) {
        Map<K, List<V>> out = new java.util.HashMap<>();
        for (V value : values) {
            out.computeIfAbsent(key.apply(value), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(value);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /* block comment
       over lines */
    public int total() {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) sum += i;
        long big = 0xFFL + 1_000L;
        char c = '\'';
        String text = """
            a text block
            """;
        return sum + (int) big + c + text.length();
    }
}
